### The Hidden Wrestle of Answered Prayer
Author: Paige Allen
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-august-19-2026.html
Passage: Genesis 25:22
Points:
- Answered prayers often arrive accompanied by unexpected difficulty and tension.
- After twenty years of barrenness, Rebekah experienced severe turmoil within her womb.
- When facing pain and confusion, Rebekah took her honest questions directly to God.
- Rather than rebuking her doubt, the Lord met her with revelation, reassurance, and peace.
- Believers are invited to approach God boldly with their wrestling hearts, trusting His presence in hard times.
